scope.method: Train vanilla and execution-adjusted alpha classifiers, rebuild one point-in-time feature snapshot per date from the same cached/DuckDB feature frame, compare alpha probability edges on the same frame, then replay both branches with the same unified 20D entry pipeline.

benchmark_contract.window_definition: same-window close-to-close over replay mark range
notes: Use this benchmark for unified replay, war room MTM, and paper-book alpha.
The benchmark window follows the replay mark range, not the prediction date alone.
